Mathematical Model:

Minimize total transportation cost:
minimize
∑_{i ∈ S} ∑_{j ∈ C} c_{i,j} x_{i,j}
where c_{i,j} are the costs as listed above.

Subject to:

1. Demand satisfaction for each customer group:
  ∑_{i ∈ S} x_{i,j} = demand_j  for all j ∈ C
  (demand_j as listed above)

2. Supply capacity for each Walmart store:
  ∑_{j ∈ C} x_{i,j} ≤ supply_capacity_i  for all i ∈ S
  (supply_capacity_i as listed above)

3. Non-negativity:
  x_{i,j} ≥ 0  for all i ∈ S, j ∈ C

All identifiers and coefficients are preserved in source order. This is a complete numerical formulation of the transportation problem as described.
